basics.name: Cristobal Cortinez Duhalde
basics.label: Data Scientist | Quantitative Modelling & Applied ML
basics.summary: Data scientist and applied mathematician with experience developing and validating financial and ML models in Chile and Canada. Combines Python, Bayesian inference, time-series methods and numerical PDEs with open-source scientific software development. Work spans credit-card limit optimisation, real-estate and mortgage-portfolio haircuts, IFRS 9 expected credit loss, inflation forecasting and NLP.
